A reported privileged-key leak led to a 402bridge ownership takeover on Base. The initial 227 wallet withdrawals moved 17,693.285835 USDC through existing approvals. A checked 3.9 ETH bridge deposit subsequently settled on Ethereum. The contract combined an owner-controlled transfer path with users' standing USDC allowances. After a reported key compromise and a verified ownership change, the new owner exercised those allowances to redirect tokens without a new user signature.
